title: Michael Talbot's death from leukemia after vampire novel
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Michael Talbot's death from leukemia after vampire novel, about 1992 at hospital, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he had written a novel about a vampire novel in which he claimed that vampireism was a rare form of leukemia and then he contracted a rare form of leukemia that killed him.
